messages:
maria (security): Hi @Erin — quick question from the auditor: they want proof that RBAC changes in the last 90 days were detected and correlated with KMS decrypt events for data access. Can we produce a minimal artifact (logs + mapping) they can review?

Erin (auditor): yes please. Need: 1) list of RBAC role changes (who, when, what) 2) CloudTrail/KMS events showing Decrypt or GenerateDataKey usage tied to those identities 3) any alerting/ACL change tickets triggered. Redact user emails if needed.

leo (eng-sre): I can pull CloudTrail and our internal RBAC change log. Quick clarifying q: do you need every change or just changes that led to data access (i.e., Decrypt events) within 7 days of the RBAC change?

Erin (auditor): ideally changes that correlate with Decrypts within 7 days. If you can provide the superset with correlation notes that's fine.

samir (platform): tagging how we'll produce this: - RBAC source = our IAM audit table (postgres) with schema: user, actor, change_type, resource, diff, changed_at - Access evidence = CloudTrail (S3) + KMS logs (CloudTrail events) - Correlation = join on principalId / ARN and time window.

leo (eng-sre): here's the Splunk/Flux-ish query I'll run on CloudTrail (rough):
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey* | stats count by userIdentity.principalId, eventName, eventTime, requestParameters.keyId, resources
```
Will also pull the KMS Decrypt JSON events for context.

maria (security): note: redact userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName for contractors, but include principalId and role arn. Also include a mapping file that maps principalId -> human name (redacted email) so auditor can see non-PII identity mapping.

Erin (auditor): that mapping is perfect. We'll accept principalId + display label. Also need retention proof: show the CloudTrail bucket lifecycle / retention policy.

samir (platform): I'll export: 1) RBAC_changes_90d.csv (columns: changed_at, actor_arn, change_type, resource, ticket_id) 2) KMS_cloudtrail_decrypt_90d.jsonl (raw events) 3) correlation_notes.md (how we matched, queries used) 4) retention_snapshot.txt (S3 lifecycle + bucket ACL)

leo (eng-sre): prepping a sample event snippet to sanity-check format:  
```
{"eventTime":"2026-02-03T14:22:10Z","eventName":"Decrypt","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","principalId":"AIDA:ABCD1234","arn":"arn:aws:sts::111222333:assumed-role/data-reader/role-session"},"requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-1234"},"resources":[{"ARN":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod/secret-file.enc"}]}
```
Let me know if that structure works for you, Erin.

Erin (auditor): yes, that's fine. Also: can you indicate which RBAC change ticket corresponds to any elevated access found? A short narrative per matched pair is helpful.

maria (security): we'll annotate correlation_notes.md with ticket links and a 2-3 line narrative for each matched RBAC->Decrypt pair. Also will flag any matches that were within a scheduled maintenance window.

leo (eng-sre): operational note: pulling full CloudTrail 90d export might be large. I'll create a filtered export for the auditor scope and generate a presigned S3 link. We'll set link TTL to 7 days.

samir (platform): FYI for packaging: we'll include an evidence_manifest.json (redacted) that lists each file + SHA256 + brief description. audit-bot will stamp the manifest when upload completes.

audit-bot: upload_started evidence-bucket/soc2/Evidence_6743219876/ RBAC_changes_90d.csv

maria (security): small ask — for any KMS Decrypt events where the key is a customer-managed key used for embeddings, redact object names but note bucket and encrypted object counts. We don't want to leak customer object keys.

leo (eng-sre): acknowledged. I'll redact S3 object key paths to top-level prefix only (e.g., s3://redwood-prod/embeddings/...) and include counts per prefix.

Erin (auditor): good. last question: incident response linkage — if any Decrypt events map to an incident or vuln triage in last 90 days, can you cross-link? We need the incident ID and the IR summary (one line).

maria (security): yes — we'll include incident crosswalk table: incident_id, incident_date, affected_resource, short_summary, evidence_files. We'll redact any sensitive playbook steps.

leo (eng-sre): running exports now. ETA ~2 hours for initial bundle. Will post presigned link when upload finishes.

audit-bot: upload_complete evidence-bucket/soc2/Evidence_6743219876/ RBAC_changes_90d.csv (sha256: abcd1234...)
__notes: Document follows agents.md: single continuous string of messages; contains required metadata fields; no title field included.
